parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the protective cap of a USB flash drive, made of plastic. It covers the metal connector to prevent dust and damage.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the USB connector when not in use and can be removed before plugging the device into a port.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached or reattached manually by sliding or pulling it off the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of plastic, housing the internal memory chip and connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components and connector that interface with computers or other devices for data transfer.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for insertion or removal from a USB port.
